historical_record.description: The Hayes Valley Housing South site held 160 dwelling units, which a conditional use application proposed to demolish for a planned unit development of 110 affordable homes and a community facility.

The City Planning Commission approved with conditions, 6-0, demolishing the 160 public housing units of Hayes Valley Housing South for a planned unit development of 110 affordable homes, a community facility and 3,000 square feet of tenant service space (Motion 13842).
